title: bug: C_Logout does not clear active operation state
description: wp11_pkcs11.c C_Logout (~4072-4143) clears key objects and logged_in status but does not clear per-session operation flags (sign_active, verify_active, encrypt_active, decrypt_active, digest_active, find_active). A sequence of: C_SignInit → C_Logout → C_Login leaves sign_active=1 with a sign_key handle from the prior login, violating session lifecycle invariants. Subsequent C_Sign may execute with a dangling or wrong key reference. Fix: in the C_Logout session-cleanup loop, explicitly zero all operation-active flags and associated state after clearing key handles.
